offering_description.value: Supplies electricity and natural gas to households, businesses and public institutions through its regulated utility networks in New York and New Jersey. It also produces and distributes district steam to buildings in Manhattan.

primary_services.value: electric power delivery; natural gas delivery; district steam delivery

customer_segment.value: B2C: households; B2B: commercial and industrial customers, building owners, and private institutions; B2G: government buildings and other public facilities

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial real estate; institutional facilities; industrial facilities; public infrastructure

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated delivery charges based on metered usage or demand; product sales: electricity and natural gas supplied to utility customers who buy their energy from the utility
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates electric grids, gas pipelines and steam plants and networks serving local utility customers; service provider: delivers energy from wholesale suppliers and customer-selected marketers to homes, businesses and public facilities

geography_served.value: US regional: New York City, Westchester County, the lower Hudson Valley and northern New Jersey

specialization.value: related lines: electricity, natural gas and district steam utilities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility accounts billed directly for service to homes, businesses and public facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: utility rates and service regulated by New York and New Jersey utility commissions, with federal oversight of interstate transmission

notes: The current scope of wholly owned transmission operations outside the regulated utilities is uncertain.
